summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a 6-K attaching a press release detailing its redomiciliation to the United States via schemes of arrangement approved by the Supreme Court of New South Wales. The company suspended trading of ASX, OTC, Nasdaq ADSs, and warrants pending completion. Shareholdings are exchanged on various ratios (e.g., one-for-one for ASX shares to CDIs, one-for-12 for OTC to NYSE American common) into new U.S.-domiciled Nova Minerals Corp, with trading expected to resume around June 16, 2026. This is a corporate reincorporation and exchange, not a special-situation transaction. Watch for completion and listing start.
